svg.aria-label: Ducks and geese near Mission. Strategy is opinion. Ducks, to 24 January: Where Wood duck country (85%). Sloughs and side channels off the Fraser (Tip). How Scout the evening before (Tip). Ducks land into the wind (80%): wind at your back (Tip). Canada geese, to 22 November, again 19 December: Where Corn stubble and pasture, almost all private: written permission first (Tip, 65%). How Find yesterday's field, hide in it before first light (Tip).
svg.text: Strategy is opinion. Each line says Tip or gives its source.
